content_policy_text: Nebras is a general-knowledge encyclopedic content platform. We do not intentionally publish any content that infringes intellectual property or copyright, nor any sexually explicit content, content harmful to children, or content promoting violence or terrorism. All content is meant to be public-domain or licensed. If you find a violation, use the "Report" button on the content and we will review and remove it promptly when confirmed.
